desc:
🦖 THE LANTERN UPDATE IS HERE! 🦖
⚔️ CLANS – create or join a clan, level it up, buy clan upgrades and fight for the TOP 3 (up to +20% luck for the whole clan!)
🥚 DINO EGGS – finish daily tasks, hatch eggs and get new pets
🌋 NEW BIOMES – the map is bigger than ever: 88 zones to throw into
🐉 5 NEW ULTRA MEGA GIANTS – the biggest dinos in the game
🎩 NEW pull animations + the LUCKY BOARD
👑 New ULTRA LIMITED dinos – only 10 and 15 in the whole world!

🎁 CODE: NEWUPDATE = 50x LUCK on your next throw!

HOW TO PLAY
🎯 Throw your harpoon into the mud – stop the slider at the top for the best throw
🦕 Pull out the dino you hit – the farther you throw, the rarer it gets (650+ dinos!)
💰 Put your dinos on your plot – they make money every second
💪 Train on the benches to get stronger and throw even farther
🌟 Find SECRET, MEGA and TITAN dinos – some are 1 in BILLIONS!
👍 Like the game if you enjoy it!
